label: v240
changes: Fixed: changes made in Members & roles — the Calendar panels switches and the country setting — didn't show up until you fully closed and reopened the app. They saved correctly, they just weren't being read again. Turning on “Name days & celebrations” now puts the panel on the calendar straight away.

Two calendar panels had no switch at all: “Birthdays beyond the family” and “Holidays & time away” could never be turned off, even though that section says you can choose which panels show. Both have a switch now.

The empty Name days panel now tells you where to actually set one — open a family member, tap Edit, then “Find a name day or celebration”. It used to point at the profile page, which shows nothing at all unless your name happens to be in a European name-day calendar.
